from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    diff=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=g[h-1-i][j]]
    c=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in diff).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i,j in diff if g[i][j]==c]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in cells),max(j for i,j in cells)
    reg=[g[i][c0:c1+1] for i in range(h-1-r1,h-1-r0+1)]
